data.body: AC amendment: Add test test_correction_hash_preserved_in_output — verify that dispatch_schema_correction() passes through the reviewer_hash field from dispatch_review() result unchanged (not recomputed, not dropped). Since dispatch_review() is mocked, assert that mock_result['reviewer_hash'] == returned_result.get('findings')[0] hash context or that the full return dict from dispatch_review is returned unmodified on success path.
